about: A profile is a named set of cases an implementation can claim: 'passes every active MUST assertion in profile P', stated together with its SHOULD results. The profile is named for the ACDC specification v1.0, whose wire is ACDC 2.00: every case uses ACDC 2.00 bytes, and nothing here tests what keripy 1.x calls ACDC 1.0 (docs/design.md, ACDC). Most ACDC refusals are inferred SHOULDs, and a validator that refuses everything passes every MUST, so a claim states its SHOULD results, and every refusal case names its positive pair. This file is generated by scripts/regenerate from scenarios/acdc/ and must not be edited. Fields: name; normative (true when every assertion cites a specification clause); spec (the pinned specification the assertions cite); cases (the case ids, in order). Disputed and deprecated cases are listed but excluded from conformance results by their status.
name: acdc-1.0
